verses.en: Why, seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty, do they that know him not see his days?
verses.pt: Por que os tempos não são marcados pelo Todo-Poderoso? Por que os que o conhecem não veem seus dias?
verses.en_web: “Why aren’t times laid up by the Almighty? Why don’t those who know him see his days?
verses.en_bbe: Why are times not stored up by the Ruler of all, and why do those who have knowledge of him not see his days?

verses.en: Some remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, and feed thereof.
verses.pt: Há os que mudam os limites de lugar, roubam rebanhos, e os apascentam.
verses.en_web: There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.
verses.en_bbe: The landmarks are changed by evil men, they violently take away flocks, together with their keepers.

verses.en: They drive away the ass of the fatherless, they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.
verses.pt: Levam o asno do órfão; penhoram o boi da viúva.
verses.en_web: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless, and they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.
verses.en_bbe: They send away the ass of him who has no father, they take the widow's ox for debt.

verses.en: They turn the needy out of the way: the poor of the earth hide themselves together.
verses.pt: Desviam do caminho aos necessitados; os pobres da terra juntos se escondem.
verses.en_web: They turn the needy out of the way. The poor of the earth all hide themselves.
verses.en_bbe: The crushed are turned out of the way; all the poor of the earth go into a secret place together.

verses.en: Behold, as wild asses in the desert, go they forth to their work; rising betimes for a prey: the wilderness yieldeth food for them and for their children.
verses.pt: Eis que como asnos selvagens no deserto eles saem a seu trabalho buscando insistentemente por comida; o deserto dá alimento a ele e a seus filhos.
verses.en_web: Behold, as wild donkeys in the desert, they go out to their work, seeking diligently for food. The wilderness yields them bread for their children.
verses.en_bbe: Like asses in the waste land they go out to their work, looking for food with care; from the waste land they get bread for their children.

verses.en: They reap every one his corn in the field: and they gather the vintage of the wicked.
verses.pt: No campo colhem sua forragem, e vindimam a vinha do perverso.
verses.en_web: They cut their food in the field. They glean the vineyard of the wicked.
verses.en_bbe: They get mixed grain from the field, and they take away the late fruit from the vines of those who have wealth.

verses.en: They cause the naked to lodge without clothing, that they have no covering in the cold.
verses.pt: Passam a noite nus, por falta de roupa; sem terem coberta contra o frio.
verses.en_web: They lie all night naked without clothing, and have no covering in the cold.
verses.en_bbe: They take their rest at night without clothing, and have no cover in the cold.

verses.en: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for want of a shelter.
verses.pt: Pelas correntes das montanhas são molhados e, não tendo abrigo, abraçam-se às rochas.
verses.en_web: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for lack of a shelter.
verses.en_bbe: They are wet with the rain of the mountains, and get into the cracks of the rock for cover.

verses.en: They pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor.
verses.pt: Há os que arrancam ao órfão do peito, e do pobre tomam penhor.
verses.en_web: There are those who pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor,
verses.en_bbe: The child without a father is forced from its mother's breast, and they take the young children of the poor for debt.

verses.en: They cause him to go naked without clothing, and they take away the sheaf from the hungry;
verses.pt: Ao nus fazem andar sem vestes, e fazem os famintos carregarem feixes.
verses.en_web: So that they go around naked without clothing. Being hungry, they carry the sheaves.
verses.en_bbe: Others go about without clothing, and though they have no food, they get in the grain from the fields.

verses.en: Which make oil within their walls, and tread their winepresses, and suffer thirst.
verses.pt: Entre suas paredes espremem o azeite; pisam nas prensas de uvas, e ainda têm sede.
verses.en_web: They make oil within the walls of these men. They tread wine presses, and suffer thirst.
verses.en_bbe: Between the lines of olive-trees they make oil; though they have no drink, they are crushing out the grapes.

verses.en: Men groan from out of the city, and the soul of the wounded crieth out: yet God layeth not folly to them.
verses.pt: Desde a cidade as pessoas gemem, e as almas dos feridos clamam; Mas Deus não dá atenção ao erro.
verses.en_web: From out of the populous city, men groan. The soul of the wounded cries out, yet God doesn’t regard the folly.
verses.en_bbe: From the town come sounds of pain from those who are near death, and the soul of the wounded is crying out for help; but God does not take note of their prayer.

verses.en: They are of those that rebel against the light; they know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.
verses.pt: Há os que se opõem à luz; não conhecem seus caminhos, nem permanecem em suas veredas.
verses.en_web: “These are of those who rebel against the light. They don’t know its ways, nor stay in its paths.
verses.en_bbe: Then there are those who are haters of the light, who have no knowledge of its ways, and do not go in them.

verses.en: The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy, and in the night is as a thief.
verses.pt: De manhã o homicida se levanta, mata ao pobre e ao necessitado, e de noite ele age como ladrão.
verses.en_web: The murderer rises with the light. He kills the poor and needy. In the night he is like a thief.
verses.en_bbe: He who is purposing death gets up before day, so that he may put to death the poor and those in need.

verses.en: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me: and disguiseth his face.
verses.pt: O olho do adúltero aguarda o crepúsculo, dizendo: Olho nenhum me verá; E esconde seu rosto.
verses.en_web: The eye also of the adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, ‘No eye shall see me.’ He disguises his face.
verses.en_bbe: And the man whose desire is for the wife of another is waiting for the evening, saying, No eye will see me; and he puts a cover on his face. And in the night the thief goes about;

verses.en: In the dark they dig through houses, which they had marked for themselves in the daytime: they know not the light.
verses.pt: Nas trevas vasculham as casas, de dia eles se trancam; não conhecem a luz.
verses.en_web: In the dark they dig through houses. They shut themselves up in the daytime. They don’t know the light.
verses.en_bbe: In the dark he makes holes in the walls of houses: in the daytime they are shutting themselves up, they have no knowledge of the light.

verses.en: For the morning is to them even as the shadow of death: if one know them, they are in the terrors of the shadow of death.
verses.pt: Porque a manhã é para todos eles como sombra de morte; pois são conhecidos dos pavores de sombra de morte.
verses.en_web: For the morning is to all of them like thick darkness, for they know the terrors of the thick darkness.
verses.en_bbe: For the middle of the night is as morning to them, they are not troubled by the fear of the dark.

verses.en: He is swift as the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth: he beholdeth not the way of the vineyards.
verses.pt: Ele é ligeiro sobre a superfície das águas; maldita é sua porção sobre a terra; não se vira para o caminho das vinhas.
verses.en_web: “They are foam on the surface of the waters. Their portion is cursed in the earth. They don’t turn into the way of the vineyards.
verses.en_bbe: They go quickly on the face of the waters; their heritage is cursed in the earth; the steps of the crusher of grapes are not turned to their vine-garden.

verses.en: Drought and heat consume the snow waters: so doth the grave those which have sinned.
verses.pt: A seca e o calor desfazem as águas da neve; assim faz o Xeol aos que pecaram.
verses.en_web: Drought and heat consume the snow waters, so does Sheol those who have sinned.
verses.en_bbe: Snow waters become dry with the heat: so do sinners go down into the underworld.

verses.en: The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree.
verses.pt: A mãe se esquecerá dele; doce será para os vermes; nunca mais haverá memória dele, e a perversidade será quebrada como um árvore.
verses.en_web: The womb shall forget him. The worm shall feed sweetly on him. He shall be no more remembered. Unrighteousness shall be broken as a tree.
verses.en_bbe: The public place of his town has no more knowledge of him, and his name has gone from the memory of men: he is rooted up like a dead tree.

verses.en: He evil entreateth the barren that beareth not: and doeth not good to the widow.
verses.pt: Aflige à mulher estéril, que não dá à luz; e nenhum bem faz à viúva.
verses.en_web: He devours the barren who don’t bear. He shows no kindness to the widow.
verses.en_bbe: He is not kind to the widow, and he has no pity for her child.

verses.en: He draweth also the mighty with his power: he riseth up, and no man is sure of life.
verses.pt: Mas Deus arranca aos poderosos com seu poder; quando Deus se levanta, não há vida segura.
verses.en_web: Yet God preserves the mighty by his power. He rises up who has no assurance of life.
verses.en_bbe: But God by his power gives long life to the strong; he gets up again, though he has no hope of life.

verses.en: Though it be given him to be in safety, whereon he resteth; yet his eyes are upon their ways.
verses.pt: Se ele lhes dá descanso, nisso confiam; mas os olhos de Deus estão postos nos caminhos deles.
verses.en_web: God gives them security, and they rest in it. His eyes are on their ways.
verses.en_bbe: He takes away his fear of danger and gives him support; and his eyes are on his ways.

verses.en: They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low; they are taken out of the way as all other, and cut off as the tops of the ears of corn.
verses.pt: São exaltados por um pouco de tempo,mas logo desaparecem; são abatidos, encerrados como todos, e cortados como cabeças das espigas.
verses.en_web: They are exalted; yet a little while, and they are gone. Yes, they are brought low, they are taken out of the way as all others, and are cut off as the tops of the ears of grain.
verses.en_bbe: For a short time they are lifted up; then they are gone; they are made low, they are pulled off like fruit, and like the heads of grain they are cut off.

verses.en: And if it be not so now, who will make me a liar, and make my speech nothing worth?
verses.pt: Se não é assim, quem me desmentirá, ou anulará minhas palavras?
verses.en_web: If it isn’t so now, who will prove me a liar, and make my speech worth nothing?”
verses.en_bbe: And if it is not so, now, who will make it clear that my words are false, and that what I say is of no value?
